description: File A is a rich chemical plant model with 10 distinct SemIDs. File B is a simplified schema with only 4 SemIDs (POS, STATE, TYPE, NAME). A→B should lose properties that B cannot represent. B→A should lose nothing since A supports all of B's SemIDs.
notes: Tests asymmetric conversion. File A has far more semantic richness than B can accommodate. The converter should correctly identify that B lacks target mappings for weight, temperature, frequency, power, size, velocity.
